# Tin

Type: Metal | Internal ID: Tin | Source: Smelter | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No | Crafting Materials: Tin ore x1

# Introduction

Tin is a crafting material smelted from Tin ore in a Smelter.
Just like Copper ore, Tin ore can only be found in the Black Forest biome. It takes the form of small shiny rock-like deposits on the ground near water (ocean & river shorelines, or small inland lakes).
An Antler pickaxe or better is required to mine the rocks, which yield 2-4 Tin ore each.
One Tin can be processed with two Copper on the Forge to create one Bronze. There is also an alternate recipe to craft 5 Bronze at a time given sufficient materials (10 copper, 5 tin).

### Building

• Cauldron
• Mead ketill

### Crafting

• Bronze
• Butcher knife

## Notes

• Like other metals, Tin cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.

Categorias: Metals, Materials, Can't be Teleported
